note: Rows checked against a page the PRODUCER publishes, one at a time.
how: Every entry here was opened, read, and compared against the row in scripts/build_catalog.py.

The figure quoted is what the producer's own page states, verbatim. Where a page disagreed with the catalogue, the CATALOGUE was corrected and the correction noted in the commit, not the other way round.

TTB's Public COLA Registry is the better source and each approval has a permanent URL, but it has no bulk access and its search is a form, so it is not what this file is built from. A producer's own page is what the catalogue already claims as its source ('Producer label'); this makes that claim checkable.
checked_on is the date somebody looked. A page can change; a date says how stale the check is.
